name: Landscapes of Taiping Prefecture ('Taiping shanshui tu')
dimensions:
each printed page: H. 24.3 x W. 31.1 cm (9 9/16 x 12 1/4 in.)
each album page, with mounting: H. 26.4 x W. 32.7 cm (10 3/8 x 12 7/8 in.)
album closed: H. 26.4 x W. 32.7 x D. 6.4 cm (10 3/8 x 12 7/8 x 2 1/2 in.)
summary: This important collection of woodblock-printed landscapes originally reproduced forty-three compositions (of which thirty-nine remain) designed by Xiao Yuncong [Hsiao Yün-ts'ung], a Ming loyalist painter from Anhui province.  Opening with a panorama of Taiping prefecture (in central Anhui) the album continues with views of scenic spots in its three districts: fifteen views from Dangtu, fourteen from Wuhu, and thirteen from Fanchang.
